title: Law Enforcement Suicide Data Collection Act
official_summary:
Law Enforcement Suicide Data Collection Act

This bill directs the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to establish a new program—the Law Enforcement Officers Suicide Data Collection Program—to prevent and understand law enforcement suicides.

Federal, state, local, and tribal law enforcement agencies may submit to the FBI, and the FBI must report on, data about suicides and attempted suicides of current and former officers.

summary.headline: This law directs the FBI to create a program that collects data on suicides and suicide attempts among law enforcement officers.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Federal Bureau of Investigation to set up a new program called the Law Enforcement Officers Suicide Data Collection Program. Federal, state, local, and tribal law enforcement agencies may send the FBI data about suicides and attempted suicides of current and former officers. The FBI must then publish reports based on this data, with the goal of preventing and understanding these deaths.

who_it_affects.group: Current and former law enforcement officers
who_it_affects.how: Their agencies may report data about suicides and suicide attempts among officers to the FBI, and the FBI will publish reports based on that data.

who_it_affects.group: Federal, state, local, and tribal law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may choose to submit suicide and suicide attempt data to the FBI for the new program.
They can use the FBI's reports to better understand law enforcement suicides.
